intro.title: Let’s find your starting point
intro.body: A few quick questions, like a game. There are no marks and nobody is judged. Your answers just help us pick the right place to begin.

level.starter: You’re at the start of the path. We’ll begin with the basics.
level.builder: You already know some things. We’ll build on them.
level.navigator: You know your way around. We’ll go further, faster.

confidence.title: How do you feel when you have to handle money?

options.c1: Worried. I’d rather someone else do it

experience.title: Which of these have you already done?

options.shop_cash: Paid for something in a shop with cash
options.upi: Used UPI or a payment app

moneySource.title: How does money for your own things usually reach you?

options.family_gives: Family gives it when I need it
options.work: I earn a little by working

goal.title: In the next one or two years, what would you most like money to help you do?

focus.title: What do you want to get better at first?

style.title: How do you like to learn?

needs.title: Which of these is a need, not a want?

saveFirst.title: Your character gets pocket money. When is the best time to save?

options.leftover: After spending, save whatever is left
options.first: Set some aside as soon as it arrives
options.big_only: Only when I have a lot of money

interest.title: ₹1,000 stays in a bank for one year and the bank pays 4% interest a year. About how much is there at the end?

prize.title: What should your character do?
prize.body: A message says: “You won ₹50,000! Pay ₹500 now to get your prize.”

options.ignore: Don’t pay. Delete it or report it
options.forward: Forward it so friends can win too

upiPin.title: True or false: to RECEIVE money on UPI, you have to enter your UPI PIN.
